task: C13 transplanted-hepatocyte state and niche feedback
status: bounded source/interface reconstruction; no new quantitative control capability
scope: Primary 2025/26 cell-state regeneration literature. No wet-lab work, external messages, medical recommendations, or publication.

claims.claim: Fang et al. report a time-resolved donor-hepatocyte regeneration program with early Afp-positive reprogramming, later proliferative Afp-low heterogeneity, and return toward mature hepatocyte identity across serial transplantation.
claims.novelty_boundary: Restates a 2026 primary-source result; not a new discovery by this work.
claims.costs: Two-round transplant model, eight scRNA-seq samples, 29,130 reported tdTomato+ cells; underlying data author-request-only.
claims.falsifier: Independent reproduction fails to observe the reported state/time pattern under the source protocol.

claims.claim: Sparse cross-sectional scRNA-seq and signature-based pseudotime do not identify transition rates separately from state-specific proliferation, death, engraftment, sampling, or host clearance.
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard mixture/compartment nonidentifiability; not counted as an advance.
claims.costs: Requires animal-level absolute counts, irreversible state lineage labels, spatial occupancy, and timed perturbation/washout to resolve.
claims.falsifier: A source-accessible longitudinal lineage dataset plus identified growth/death inputs yields unique transition rates from the reported measurements.

claims.claim: Under linear determinacy, irreducibility, and a cooperative two-state branching-diffusion model, the invasion speed is c*=inf_{lambda>0} s(D lambda^2 + A)/lambda, with s the spectral abscissa.
claims.status: standard conditional model identity; no novelty claimed
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard linear determinacy formula applied as a candidate interface only; source parameters are not acquired.
claims.costs: Needs estimated state-specific growth/transition matrix A and spatial diffusivity D; neither is numerically identified by public source material.
claims.falsifier: Nonlinear front behavior violates linear determinacy or observed spatial invasion speed disagrees with the parameterized model.

next_gate: Only resume with public/authorized animal-level lineage and spatial data that identify transition, growth, death, and transport separately; compare against equally informed selection-only and homogeneous-state controls.
